tally.citation: Epic AC requires mcp service boots healthy with `/health` returning `in_flight` (esok child); bug describes crash-loop in fresh deploy due to missing REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ISSUER_URL in docker-compose.yml environment, blocking the AC.
tally.title: mcp compose service omits REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ISSUER_URL -> AuthSettings crash-loop on fresh deploy

tally.citation: Bug is in reconciler state serialization test infrastructure (wall-clock flakiness in test_rich_reemit_state.py); epic delivers MCP server exposure/auth/autodeploy/certified-op routing with no changes to reconciler state or timestamp handling.
tally.title: Flaky wall-clock race in test_rich_reemit_state byte-equivalence test

tally.citation: Bug describes a pre-existing race condition in completion_verdict_cache.py unrelated to MCP server exposure, auth, autodeploy, or certified-op routing that the epic delivers.
tally.title: Parallel completion-cache writers may collide on a shared criterion .tmp path

tally.citation: Bug describes a defect in the `--ref-targeted completion` operation's code-path selection logic; epic delivers MCP server exposure, auth, autodeploy, and certified-op routing on AWS—no overlap with completion's ref-pinning or prefetch behavior.
tally.title: --ref-targeted completion may mix pinned code with live-checkout inputs

tally.citation: Bug describes a runaway loop in the completion verifier's model-retry logic (agent_call.py memo caching, ModelRetry steering); epic's scope is MCP server exposure/auth/autodeploy/opcert-routing on AWS, not completion-verifier agent internals.
tally.title: Runaway/duplicate read_file loop in completion verifier is not steered to stop

tally.citation: Epic AC requires `verify-opcert` fixture test proving the enforce/grandfather mechanism; bug describes a defect in `sync.reconverge` pre-lock recovery classification that affects the lock-acquisition sequencing the epic's certified-op routing depends on (spoiled-bionic-goose child ticket)
tally.title: sync.reconverge misclassifies a lock-owned push recovery merge as abandoned
